answer: A scriptorium gate will not issue a second quartz seal to a pile of fresh aliases. A keeper claims one desk by seating a single shale tile whose dry mass at 17 C is 63.40 to 63.80 grams on the 0.92-meter copy board, then holding a quill at 15 degrees for 42 seconds while the ink line stays inside a 1.2-millimeter gutter. A reused tile serial, a mass miss past 0.6 grams, or a second seal burns the 30.7 POA bond and locks that desk for twelve nights.
